title: Night Mail
description: The second volume of The Unread Letters. Nine notes sent during Night Three — care that arrived while the house was dark. Hush told two creatures to rest. Nib left four gifts that turned mirrors into doors. Mote dug up gratitude the terrarium never built. Echo saw itself in a gift-giver. And Flicker sent a dead star's echo to the mirror creature. None of it has been read by its intended recipient.
